highlights:
Sabrina Carpenter has secured the biggest opening week for an album by an international artist in the UK so far this year. Man’s Best Friend (Polydor) debuted at the summit with consumption of 85,305 units (12,911 CDs, 27,178 vinyl albums, 7,214 cassettes, 825 digital downloads and 37,177 sales-equivalent streams). That was a similar performance to last year’s Short ’N Sweet album, which managed 89,658 in its opening frame. Man’s Best Friend also outsold the No.2 album by a margin of more than five to one and the rest of the Top 10 combined.
